notes: Maps raw quota strings observed in MCC-derived mirrors (crockzo 2025, rahuldathu 2024) to canonical quota codes. Raw values are preserved on every normalized record (raw_quota). Source legend: MCC R1 2025 PDF abbreviations page. Spacing/typo variants of the same quota are expected from PDF extraction and all map to one canonical code.

mappings._note_AD_AM: AD=DNB and AM=AMU confirmed empirically 2026-09-19: 9237/9239 AD rows in rahuldathu 2024 carry (NBEMS) course prefixes at DNB hospitals; AM rows are at AMU's JN Medical College. The MCC legend's interleaved two-column layout makes positional pairing ambiguous — data evidence settled it.
